facts.claim: The municipality of Rander had an average income of about Rs. 20,000 during the decade ending 1901 and Rs. 23,000 in 1903-4.
facts.quote: the municipality, established in 1868, had an average income of about Rs. 20,000 during the decade ending 1901 ; in 1903-4 the income was Rs. 23,000.
